interface.description: Network interface name to sniff packets from

new_only.description: If true, only track connections started after tcptrack launch (-d)

fast_average.description: If true, use fast average recalculation for bandwidth stats (-f)

non_promiscuous.description: If true, do not set interface to promiscuous mode (-p)

remove_delay.description: Seconds to keep closed connections in display before removal (-r)

pcap_file.description: Path to a pcap file to read from instead of live interface (-T)
